prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean Liberty, Missouri (near Kansas City)? And is this for a residential irrigation/household backflow device or a commercial/industrial device (fire line, commercial irrigation, etc.)?

If you want immediate options, two quick paths:

1) Fast and reliable: contact the City of Liberty Utilities / Water Department or Public Works and ask for their list of approved/certified backflow testers. Many municipalities keep a list or can tell you the requirements for who can submit test results.

2) Types of businesses that commonly do testing/repair near Liberty:
   - Local plumbing companies that employ certified backflow testers
   - Irrigation/sprinkler companies (residential test & repair)
   - Fire protection contractors (for fire-line backflow assemblies)
   - Dedicated backflow testing companies

What to look for when you contact a vendor:
   - Certified backflow assembly tester (ask for their certification number)
   - Proof of insurance and bonding
   - They will provide a written test report and, if required, file results with the city
   - Typical price range: roughly $60–$150 for a residential test (repairs extra; costs vary by device and parts)

If you want, I can search for specific certified testers and companies near Liberty, MO and list names, phone numbers and reviews — tell me if you want residential or commercial, and share a ZIP code or how far you want to travel.
